only 3 validation windows: weight estimation is high variance
diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong downward trend (a net fall of ~19% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.041), which favours a robust combination.

Series context: trend strength 1.0 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.041); 11 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 5.014.
